name: aurora
title: Aurora
description: Green and violet aurora curtains ripple across a night sky.
useWhen: A night-sky or northern-lights backdrop behind a title, product shot or quote.
A calm, glowing background in two colors of your choosing.
avoidWhen: You want a soft blended palette with no sky: use shader-mesh-gradient.
The render budget is tight: lower `resolution`; WebGL runs in software on CPU render machines.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Upper color
variables.description: Color of the curtains' upper reach.

variables.label: Lower color
variables.description: Color of the curtains' glowing lower edge.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Waviness
variables.description: How strongly the curtains ripple sideways.

variables.label: Ray detail
variables.description: How many vertical rays run through the curtains.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it if edges look soft.
